verification.scope: offline read-only inspection of user-supplied original JAR

notes: The original client binary is private and is not committed.
The build number 311 comes from the actual class ConstantValue; filename alone is not authority.
This is a new official-client baseline, not a claim that the recovered source produces byte-identical v311 classes.
Prior v308 and v309 authorities are historical migration references. Their project recovery artifacts must not be silently relabeled as v311.
Use the existing spk-recovery update-intake pipeline with independently SHA-verified old index and original client JAR to obtain genuine changed/added/removed class evidence.

Observed absence of rs/Scene.class or rs/s/e/c.class as paths in the official v311 ZIP does not prove scene/feature removal; bytecode matching must establish potential renamed equivalents before carrying R308 changes.

project_class_surface.digest_construction: SHA256 of UTF-8 rows sorted by full class entry path: path + NUL + lowercase SHA256(class bytes) + LF
